description: Quantify PeptideAtlas observation depth for canonical ITIH5 versus isoform-diagnostic peptides
code:
import requests, re, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

seqs={}
for iso in ["Q86UX2-1","Q86UX2-2","Q86UX2-3","Q86UX2-4"]:
    seqs[iso]="".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{iso}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])

def tryptic(s, missed=1, minlen=7, maxlen=30):
    sites=[0]+[i+1 for i in range(len(s)-1) if s[i] in "KR" and s[i+1]!="P"]+[len(s)]
    out=set()
    for i in range(len(sites)-1):
        for m in range(missed+1):
            j=i+1+m
            if j<len(sites):
                p=s[sites[i]:sites[j]]
                if minlen<=len(p)<=maxlen: out.add(p)
    return out

def pa_obs(pep, build=572):
    u=("https://db.systemsbiology.net/sbeams/cgi/PeptideAtlas/GetPeptides"
       f"?atlas_build_id={build}&peptide_sequence_constraint={pep}&action=QUERY&output_mode=tsv")
    try:
        r=requests.get(u,timeout=90)
        lines=[l for l in r.text.strip().split("\n") if l.strip()]
        if len(lines)<2: return 0
        for l in lines[1:]:
            f=l.split("\t")
            if len(f)>3 and f[1]==pep:
                try: return int(f[3])
                except: return 0
        return 0
    except Exception:
        return None

canon=sorted(tryptic(seqs["Q86UX2-1"],missed=0,minlen=7,maxlen=30))
print(f"canonical fully-tryptic peptides (7-30 aa, 0 missed): {len(canon)}")
sample=canon[:55]
obs=[]
for p in sample:
    obs.append(pa_obs(p)); time.sleep(0.15)
obs=np.array([o if o is not None else -1 for o in obs])
det=(obs>0)
print(f"PeptideAtlas Human 2024-01 (build 572): {det.sum()}/{len(sample)} canonical ITIH5 peptides observed "
      f"({100*det.mean():.0f}%); median observations among detected = {int(np.median(obs[det])) if det.any() else 0}; "
      f"max = {obs.max()}")

diag={
 "isoform 2":["DGVFPLHHLGIR","HGRDGVFPLHHLGIR","GAGTQPGPLLKKPNSVK","KPNSVKK"],
 "isoform 3":["MRNYDSGPPPSTVINQNETFANIIFKPTVVQQAR","NYDSGPPPSTVINQNETFANIIFKPTVVQQAR"],
 "isoform 4":["TYDTPGTSMCIIPDDPHR","MRTYDTPGTSMCIIPDDPHR","RFYDEIR","DAVVCGLR","DAVVCGLRVR","AKDAVVCGLR","ISKTSGK"],
}
print("\n=== Observations of isoform-diagnostic peptides ===")
rows=[]
for iso,peps in diag.items():
    for p in peps:
        n=pa_obs(p); time.sleep(0.15)
        rows.append(dict(isoform=iso,peptide=p,length=len(p),n_observations=n))
        print(f"  {iso}  {p:36s} len={len(p):2d}  n_obs={n}")
dd=pd.DataFrame(rows)
dd.to_csv("/agent/jobs/751146a9-dc23-49c8-ac3a-da13249e67c2/provenance/itih5_peptideatlas_diagnostic.csv",index=False)
pd.DataFrame({"peptide":sample,"n_observations":obs}).to_csv(
    "/agent/jobs/751146a9-dc23-49c8-ac3a-da13249e67c2/provenance/itih5_peptideatlas_canonical.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.4))
ax[0].hist(np.log10(obs[det]),bins=18,color="#2b6cb0")
ax[0].set_xlabel("log10(observations in PeptideAtlas Human 2024-01)")
ax[0].set_ylabel("canonical ITIH5 peptides")
ax[0].set_title(f"Canonical ITIH5 is well observed\n{det.sum()}/{len(sample)} peptides detected",fontsize=10)
lens=dd.length.values; nobs=dd.n_observations.fillna(0).values
colmap={"isoform 2":"#dd6b20","isoform 3":"#2b6cb0","isoform 4":"#2f855a"}
for iso in dd.isoform.unique():
    sub=dd[dd.isoform==iso]
    ax[1].scatter(sub.length, sub.n_observations.fillna(0)+0.1, s=70, color=colmap[iso], label=iso)
ax[1].axhspan(0.05,0.2,color="#c53030",alpha=0.12)
ax[1].set_yscale("log"); ax[1].set_ylim(0.05,1e4)
ax[1].set_xlabel("peptide length (aa)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("observations (0 plotted at 0.1)")
ax[1].set_title("No isoform-diagnostic peptide has any observation",fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
plt.suptitle("PeptideAtlas evidence: ITIH5 protein is detected, but no peptide unique to isoform 2, 3 or 4 has ever been observed",fontsize=11.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
